title: Association stages hunger protest demanding regularisation of jobs

ai.summary: Tamil Nadu AIDS Control All Employees Welfare Association staged a hunger protest demanding permanent job security for contractual staff who have worked for over five years at TANSACS.

facts.claim: Tamil Nadu AIDS Control All Employees Welfare Association staged a hunger protest
facts.quote: The Tamil Nadu AIDS Control All Employees Welfare Association on Friday staged a hunger protest demanding regularisation of contractual employees who have been working under the Tamil Nadu State AIDS Control Society (TANSACS) for over five years.

facts.claim: demanding regularisation of contractual employees who have been working under TANSACS for over five years
facts.quote: the hunger protest was held with a single demand that all contractual staff of Tamil Nadu State AIDS Control Society (TANSACS), who have been in continuous service for more than five years, should be provided permanent job security.

ai.background_note: TANSACS staff have worked for over 30 years with the State’s Health department, but continue to be on contractual basis despite government promises to regularise such staff after five years.
